items.heading: Tomato Pappu
details: Key ingredients: toor dal, tomato, garlic, turmeric, green chili, mustard seeds
Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric until soft and mushy.
Saute garlic and green chili, then add chopped tomato and cook until pulpy.
Mix the mashed dal into the tomato base and simmer until well combined.
Finish with a mustard seed and cumin tempering in ghee.

items.heading: Palakura Pappu
details: Key ingredients: toor dal, spinach, garlic, green chili, cumin
Pressure-cook toor dal with chopped spinach and turmeric until soft.
Mash the dal and greens together to a coarse consistency.
Saute garlic and cumin in ghee until fragrant.
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer briefly before serving.

items.heading: Gongura Pappu
details: Key ingredients: toor dal, gongura (sorrel) leaves, garlic, dried red chili
Pressure-cook toor dal with roughly chopped gongura leaves until soft.
Mash together so the tangy leaves blend through the dal.
Temper garlic, dried red chili and cumin seeds in oil.
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer for a few minutes.

items.heading: Dosakaya Pappu
details: Key ingredients: toor dal, dosakaya (yellow cucumber), turmeric, mustard seeds
Pressure-cook toor dal with diced dosakaya and turmeric until tender.
Lightly mash, keeping some texture from the cucumber.
Temper mustard seeds, cumin, dried red chili and curry leaves in oil.
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer briefly before serving.

items.heading: Chepala Pulusu
details: Key ingredients: fish, tamarind, onion, dried red chili, fenugreek seeds
Saute onion and dried red chili in oil until softened.
Add tamarind extract and a little jaggery for a sweet-sour balance.
Bring the tangy gravy to a simmer and slide in fish pieces.
Cook gently without stirring too much, until the fish is done and the gravy thickens.

items.heading: Royyala Vepudu
details: Key ingredients: prawns, turmeric, red chili powder, curry leaves, onion
Marinate cleaned prawns briefly with turmeric and chili powder.
Saute onion and curry leaves in oil until golden.
Add the prawns and cook on high heat, tossing often.
Fry until the prawns are dry-roasted and lightly charred at the edges.

items.heading: Egg Bhurji
details: Key ingredients: eggs, onion, tomato, green chili, turmeric
Saute chopped onion and green chili until softened.
Add tomato and turmeric, cooking until it breaks down slightly.
Crack in eggs and scramble everything together over medium heat.
Cook until just set and serve hot with bread or roti.

items.heading: Andhra Aloo Fry
details: Key ingredients: potatoes, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chili powder, turmeric
Boil or par-cook diced potatoes until just tender.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and dried red chili in oil.
Add the potatoes along with turmeric and chili powder.
Fry on medium-high heat, tossing often, until crisp and golden at the edges.

items.heading: Bendakaya Vepudu
details: Key ingredients: okra, onion, red chili powder, tamarind, mustard seeds
Slice okra and pat dry thoroughly to reduce stickiness.
Temper mustard seeds and add sliced onion, cooking until soft.
Add the okra with red chili powder and a touch of tamarind.
Fry uncovered on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp.

items.heading: Vankaya Fry
details: Key ingredients: brinjal (eggplant), red chili powder, turmeric, mustard seeds, peanuts
Cut brinjal into batons and soak briefly in water to prevent browning.
Temper mustard seeds and crushed peanuts in oil.
Add the brinjal with turmeric and red chili powder.
Fry on medium heat until the brinjal is tender and lightly crisp at the edges.

items.heading: Gutti Vankaya Kura
details: Key ingredients: small brinjals, peanuts, sesame seeds, coconut, tamarind
Dry roast peanuts, sesame seeds and coconut, then grind into a coarse masala paste.
Slit small brinjals into quarters and stuff generously with the ground masala.
Shallow fry the stuffed brinjals briefly in oil until lightly seared.
Simmer with a little tamarind water and remaining masala until the brinjals are soft.

items.heading: Mamsam Kura
details: Key ingredients: mutton, onion, tomato, red chili powder, garam masala, curry leaves
Marinate mutton pieces with turmeric and a little yogurt for at least an hour.
Saute onion until deep golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and cook through.
Add tomato, chili powder and garam masala, cooking until the oil separates.
Add the mutton and pressure-cook or simmer slowly until fully tender.

items.heading: Natu Kodi Pulusu
details: Key ingredients: country chicken, tamarind, onion, roasted peanuts, red chili
Saute onion and dried red chili in oil until softened and fragrant.
Add a coarse paste of roasted peanuts and grated coconut, cooking briefly.
Add country chicken pieces and cook on low heat, letting them release flavor slowly.
Stir in tamarind extract and simmer gently until the chicken is tender and the gravy is thick.

items.heading: Chepa Vepudu
details: Key ingredients: fish fillets, turmeric, red chili powder, semolina or rice flour
Marinate fish fillets with turmeric, red chili powder and a little lemon juice.
Coat lightly in semolina or rice flour for a crisp crust.
Shallow fry in hot oil over medium heat until golden on one side.
Flip carefully and fry the other side until crisp and cooked through.

items.heading: Cauliflower Vepudu
details: Key ingredients: cauliflower florets, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chili powder, turmeric
Blanch cauliflower florets briefly in hot water and drain well.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and dried red chili in oil.
Add the florets along with turmeric and red chili powder.
Fry on medium-high heat, tossing often, until crisp and golden at the edges.

items.heading: Chicken 65
details: Key ingredients: boneless chicken, red chili powder, curd, curry leaves, garlic
Marinate boneless chicken pieces in curd, red chili powder, garlic and ginger paste.
Coat lightly in cornflour and deep fry until golden and crisp.
Temper garlic, green chili and curry leaves in a little oil in a separate pan.
Toss the fried chicken through the tempering until well coated and serve hot.

items.heading: Gongura Rice
details: Key ingredients: cooked rice, gongura (sorrel) leaves, dried red chili, garlic
Saute gongura leaves until wilted and reduced, then cool slightly.
Grind with dried red chilies and garlic into a coarse, tangy paste.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, then add the gongura paste.
Mix thoroughly through cooked rice until evenly distributed.

items.heading: Perugu Annam
details: Key ingredients: cooked rice, yogurt, milk, mustard seeds, curry leaves, pomegranate
Mash cooked rice lightly while still warm, then let it cool.
Stir in yogurt and a splash of milk until smooth and creamy.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger and green chili in oil.
Pour the tempering over the curd rice and garnish with pomegranate before serving chilled.

items.heading: Ariselu
details: Key ingredients: rice flour, jaggery, sesame seeds, ghee
Soak rice and sun-dry before grinding into a fine flour.
Melt jaggery with a little water into a thick syrup and mix into the rice flour to form a soft dough.
Shape into small flattened discs and press sesame seeds onto both sides.
Deep fry on low heat until golden brown and glossy.

items.heading: Sunnundalu
details: Key ingredients: urad dal, jaggery or sugar, ghee, cardamom
Dry roast urad dal until fragrant and lightly golden, then cool completely.
Grind into a fine powder along with cardamom.
Mix in powdered jaggery or sugar and warm ghee until the mixture holds together.
Shape into small round balls while still slightly warm.

items.heading: Upma
details: Key ingredients: semolina (rava), onion, green chili, mustard seeds, curry leaves
Dry roast semolina until lightly fragrant and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and green chili in oil until softened.
Add water and bring to a boil, then lower the heat.
Slowly stir in the roasted semolina, whisking to avoid lumps, until it thickens and cooks through.

items.heading: Punugulu
details: Key ingredients: leftover idli or dosa batter, onion, green chili, curry leaves
Mix leftover fermented batter with chopped onion, green chili and curry leaves.
Adjust consistency with a little rice flour if the batter is too thin.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and deep fry until golden and puffed.
Drain well and serve hot with coconut or ginger chutney.

items.heading: Mirchi Bajji
details: Key ingredients: large green chilies, gram flour (besan), rice flour, ajwain
Slit large mild green chilies and remove the seeds if a milder bajji is preferred.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, ajwain and a little water into a thick batter.
Dip each chili into the batter, coating evenly.
Deep fry until the coating is crisp and golden, then drain and serve hot.

items.heading: Avakaya
details: Key ingredients: raw mango, red chili powder, mustard powder, fenugreek, sesame oil
Cut raw mango into pieces with the seed intact and pat completely dry.
Mix red chili powder, mustard powder, fenugreek and salt into a coarse masala.
Toss the mango pieces thoroughly with the masala until well coated.
Pour sesame oil over the mixture to cover, then let it mature in a jar for several days before serving.

items.heading: Perugu Pachadi
details: Key ingredients: yogurt, cucumber or onion, green chili, mustard seeds, curry leaves
Whisk yogurt until smooth and season lightly with salt.
Fold in finely chopped cucumber or onion and green chili.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in a little oil.
Pour the tempering over the yogurt mixture and stir gently before serving chilled.
